note: A synthetic client (Slice 116 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: Our quarterly operating expenses were $2.4 million against a budget of $2.1 million. We need to explain the overrun to the board and forecast next quarter.

answers.common.decision: Whether to cut discretionary spend next quarter; the CFO decides.
answers.common.deadline: Board pack due in ten days.
answers.common.materials: Contractor spend was $600,000 against a plan of $350,000. Travel was $180,000 against $200,000. Headcount costs matched budget.
answers.finance-modeling.purpose: Explain the variance and forecast next quarter.
answers.finance-modeling.data: Quarterly actuals and budget by cost line, in US dollars.
